name: linkedin-connections-dashboard
description: Chrome extension to display LinkedIn connections in a dashboard

scripts.build: vite build && copy manifest.json dist\manifest.json && copy dist\src\popup.html dist\popup.html && powershell -Command "(Get-Content dist\popup.html) -replace 'src=\"/popup.js\"', 'src=\"./popup.js\"' | Set-Content dist\popup.html"
